### Jesus Turns the Tables
Author: Jonathan Parnell
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/jesus-turns-the-tables
Passage: Mark 11:15
Points:
- Jesus entered the temple with righteous authority rather than passive tolerance, confronting corrupt worship.
- Commercial trading had overrun the Court of the Gentiles, crowding out non-Jewish seekers.
- Israel's religious leaders had lost sight of God's prophetic vision to welcome nations and outcasts.
- Modern churches must examine whether their gatherings truly welcome the marginalized or merely maintain an impressive appearance.

### Cleansing the Temple
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/cleansing-the-temple-2
Passage: Matthew 21:12-17
Points:
- Disciples expected Jesus to judge Roman oppressors, but He confronted corruption among His own people instead.
- Commercial haggling in the Court of the Gentiles prevented non-Jewish worshipers from seeking God.
- Jesus acted with holy zeal to restore pure worship and unobstructed access to the Father.
- Followers of Christ must actively help others reach God rather than placing stumbling blocks in their path.
